purpose: Target one-third of complete one-glove delivered cash cost while preserving capability and qualification requirements.

requirements.imu_acquisition: Both six-axis 833 Hz, ±4 g / ±1000 dps, timestamped tagged FIFO bursts on 400 kHz I2C; separate cuff/camera and hand motion.
requirements.camera: colour JPEG, near-finger optics, continuous capture
requirements.camera_candidate: CamThink 73.002.000035 OV5640 120 degree, 8 cm fixed focus
requirements.control: one large top button: hold on, continue hold pair, hold while on shutdown
requirements.charging: USB-C, protected single lithium cell, temperature-qualified power path
requirements.construction: factory assembled electronics, keyed plug-in glove harnesses, soft sensing stack, removable cuff

industrial_design.dimension_interpretation: Width and length viewed from above; minimise thickness separately.
industrial_design.size_status: Preferred target; current electrical placement and battery exceed it.
industrial_design.form: Slim rounded rectangle; curvature optional. Minimise mounting stack.
industrial_design.larger_size_requires: Evidence-backed component, wiring and tolerance dimensions shown before ordering.
industrial_design.fabrication_candidate: JLC3DP MJF PA12 shell with separately specified flexible, optical and cut parts.
industrial_design.process_release: Pass vendor-specific dimensional and assembly checks before first-article fabrication; physical qualification follows first-article build.

additional_preserved_requirements.tactile_signal_chain: 20 independent charge front ends, local overload protection and per-channel anti-alias filtering before multiplexing; preserve or improve measured/modelled usable bandwidth, noise, crosstalk and recovery.
additional_preserved_requirements.camera_profile: VGA JPEG target 9.99756 frames/s throughout six-hour recording; preserve selected near-finger field of view/focus and timestamps/drop accounting.
additional_preserved_requirements.factory_scope: Factory assembled and programmed electronics, prepared keyed harnesses; Peter only fits sensing materials and plugs finished connections.
additional_preserved_requirements.physical_scope: Preserve softness, anatomical pad locations and assembly accessibility; keep preferred cuff footprint as an open requirement.
additional_preserved_requirements.tracking_scope: Existing precise hidden-hand position, joint-pose and calibrated roughness gaps remain engineering requirements; cost equivalence does not establish those capabilities.

cost_policy.primary_metric: Cash needed to receive one complete usable right-hand glove in Sofia, including all mandatory order quantities, materials, preparation, assembly, flashing, test, enclosure, battery, shipping, tax and fees.
cost_policy.exchange_rate_policy: Retain original currencies; require dated conversion basis before aggregating. Never subtract tax-inclusive from tax-exclusive amounts as a savings claim.
cost_policy.batch_policy: Show batch unit cost separately. Entire mandatory purchase counts for one-glove cash outlay; shared assembler stock can reduce outlay only through an actual cut-material/consumables service quote.
cost_policy.success_policy: A cost-reduced alternative is selected only with preserved capabilities, same engineering release checks, and comparable complete quotes. Threefold saving is a target, not an achieved result.
cost_policy.fallback_policy: If one-third cost is unattainable, select the lowest supported complete cost that passes the same capability and engineering gates. No purchase authorization.
